messages:
rachel.prod: Short thread to resolve headroom and launch gates for Dedicated GA. Exec asked for a crisp list we can commit to. Key open items: headroom default, carryover policy (paid vs GA), autoscale cooldowns, and cross-region fallback behavior. Thoughts?
omar.eng: My view: pick conservative defaults for GA to reduce risk. Proposal: headroom=12% of pool, cooldown=300s, hysteresis=15%. Carryover should be a paid add-on and opt-in for pilots only.
toni.infra: From infra ops: enforce AZ spread (no AZ >85% reserved), and add a soft cap so no single region can own >28% of global burst headroom by default. We'll also emit a metric `dedicated.headroom.available_by_az` for visibility.
sara.se: SE feedback: pilots want a visible burst balance and an API to query expected refill time. UI mock should show live burst usage + last prewarm events. Keep hourly windows as pilot-only for now.
ben.sales: Pilots: two fintechs asked for carryover between windows specifically. They'll pay for it if pricing is clear. Make carryover a separate SKU and default it off.
alice.finance: For billing mapping we need metric names and a sample invoice line. propose: `reserved_commit_units`, `burst_tokens_used`, `carryover_credits_consumed`. Finance will model 3 pilot customers impact if we get estimates.
runbook-bot: Note: scheduled canary run "dedicated-smoke-headroom" in eu-west at 1766068000. Logs will land in #eng-telemetry.
omar.eng: Operational corner-case: tenant with `region_affinity=strict` and exhausted local capacity -> return 503 with code `DEDICATED_LOCAL_EXHAUSTED`. Otherwise, fallback to same-account region if allowed. Need to document.
toni.infra: Also suggest an admission control rule: if pool_gpus < 4, cap headroom to max 1 GPU to avoid tiny pools exploding. We'll implement: `headroom_gpus = min(ceil(pool_gpus*0.12), max(1, floor(pool_gpus*0.2)))` (we can refine).
sara.se: UX action: I'll wireframe burst meter + carryover opt-in toggle and show prewarm_eviction history.
ben.sales: Action: I'll confirm pilot list and who's willing to pay for carryover.
alice.finance: Action: need estimated burst token counts from eng for modeling.
omar.eng: Action: I'll run short sims for conservative defaults across typical tenant mixes and post results by Wed EOD (1766154290).
toni.infra: Action: capacity sims for us-west/eu-west showing AZ spread & regional cap. due Thu noon.
rachel.prod: Draft GA acceptance checklist (working):
- conservative headroom default implemented (12%) with small-pool clamping
- autoscale defaults: cooldown=300s, hysteresis=15%
- AZ spread and regional headroom caps enforced
- telemetry: dedicated.headroom.available_by_az, dedicated.prewarm.count, dedicated.spillover.count, dedicated.burst.tokens_used
- billing metric mapping documented and carryover SKU defined (off by default)
- error behavior for region_affinity=strict documented (503 + `DEDICATED_LOCAL_EXHAUSTED`)
If we hit these, we mark carryover and hourly windows as post-GA paid features. anyone object?
ben.sales: no objections, we need the pricing model soon.
alice.finance: we'll wait for eng simulation numbers.
sara.se: OK from SE side.
omar.eng: fine, will target sims.
rachel.prod: Cool — I'm locking conservative gates for the roadmap entry and moving carryover/hourly to the post-GA bucket unless a paying pilot requests otherwise. I'll publish the checklist after the sims. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Single Slack thread; messages concatenated per agents.md; short casual style
